summary: Iteration 10 (Gallery). Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (upload jpeg/png, text rejected, no-token unauthorized, public list sorted asc, file serve with Cache-Control, unknown 404, patch caption, patch empty=400, patch unknown=404, reorder, delete + verify gone + delete-again 404). Frontend: admin /admin/gallery upload via file input triggers progress, toast 'ajouté à la galerie', new card, caption edit + save toast 'Légende enregistrée', move up/down work, delete accepts confirm and toast 'Média retiré'. Landing #gallery section renders, tiles load (naturalWidth>0), lightbox opens and Escape closes it, next/prev cycle. Language switch to EN shows 'Our flights, for real.'. Admin nav renders on single row at 1920 and 1366 (all 6 tabs, rows=1). Mobile admin-nav-mobile visible at 390px. Left gallery with only 'Test vol du matin' at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >780 lines; consider splitting into routers (gallery, vouchers, reviews, admin) for maintainability.
Upload endpoint reads the whole file into memory before size check — could DoS memory. Consider streaming/size cap header check before read().

The public /api/gallery ordering uses (order asc, created_at desc). Reorder only updates matched ids; if a stale id list is submitted, non-listed items keep old orders which can collide with new ones (no gap resolution). Not blocking but could produce inconsistent ordering.
PATCH /api/admin/gallery: setting caption to only whitespace results in caption=None (silent). Fine but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleaned up my TEST_ uploads; left the pre-existing 'Test vol du matin' item as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery routes at /api/gallery (public) and /api/admin/gallery (bearer). Emergent Object Storage is soft-delete only. When running pytest with parallel xdist (default config in /app/backend/pytest.ini), use `-o addopts=` to force sequential; test file uses module-level state that xdist splits across workers. Landing lang switcher testids: lang-switcher-fr/en/es. Admin nav testids: admin-nav (desktop md+) / admin-nav-mobile (< md, 768).
